note: FLUX-tuned curated prompts. Natural-language style (NOT Stable Diffusion keyword soup), because FLUX.1 is trained on descriptive captions.

cards.title: 海邊老漁夫
cards.zh: 風霜臉孔的老漁夫，自然光人像
cards.en: A natural-light portrait of an old fisherman with weathered, sun-creased skin and kind tired eyes, soft directional window light from the left, shallow depth of field, shot on an 85mm lens, muted earthy tones, quiet and dignified.

cards.title: 霓虹下的女子
cards.zh: 雨夜霓虹街頭的電影感人像
cards.en: A cinematic close-up of a young woman standing on a rainy city street at night, magenta and teal neon reflecting on her face and wet skin, soft bokeh of blurred signs behind her, moody film-still atmosphere, 50mm lens.

cards.title: 陽光少年
cards.zh: 逆光金色時刻的自然笑容

cards.title: 職人黑白

cards.title: 星空沙漠

cards.title: 極簡耳機

cards.title: 香水光影

cards.title: 潑濺飲料

cards.title: 液態金屬
